title: Keep on screen
prompt: The screen runs from (0, 0) to (screen_w, screen_h). Return the rectangle moved the smallest amount needed so it is fully on screen. Its size stays the same.
signature: func solve(r: Rect2, screen_w: float, screen_h: float) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(r: Rect2, screen_w: float, screen_h: float) -> Rect2:
	return r
hint: Clamp x between 0 and screen_w minus the width; same for y with the height.
